title: Threshold sign on negative inputs
statement: Let $r\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r<0$, and define $sigma(t)=1$ when $t\ge0$ and $sigma(t)=-1$ when $t<0$. Then $sigma(r)=-1$.
replaced:
Let $r\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r<0$, and define $\sigma(t)=1$ for $t\ge0$ and
$\sigma(t)=-1$ for $t<0$.
Then $\sigma(r)=-1$.
